artworks.name: River at dawn
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original flat 2D museum artwork texture for a low-poly Roblox Kolkata heritage museum. This request is for the image printed on the canvas itself, not a painting object or a room.
Format and camera: exact landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, perfectly flat and front-facing, edge-to-edge artwork filling every pixel. No frame, border, mat, mount, canvas edge, easel, wall, room, perspective view of an image, cast shadow, glass reflection, signature, watermark, logo or text. No bevel or 3D relief.
Medium and fidelity: deliberately simplified 2D colour-block print / painted poster, broad crisp shapes, modest layered silhouettes, restrained paperlike colour variation only if very subtle. It must read cleanly at 480 by 320 pixels and from a game camera. No photorealism, micro-detail, intricate architecture, photo textures or tiny linework.
Coherent museum palette: parchment ivory, muted deep teal, desaturated river blue, charcoal ink, warm ochre/brass and a restrained terracotta accent. About six to eight broad colour families, warm elegant Kolkata/heritage feeling. Original fictional composition, not a copy of any existing painting, poster or photograph. No detailed human faces. Flat pictorial illustration may use natural scene depth, but the artwork as a whole must have no perspective distortion.
Composition: quiet Hooghly-inspired river at dawn, horizontal bands of parchment sky and desaturated blue water. Foreground: one dark simple wooden boat and an ivory triangular sail, offset to the lower left rather than centered. Midground: broad flat riverbank masses, no tiny people or crowded ghats. Background: a distant condensed cantilever bridge silhouette suggested by four or five broad triangular truss shapes, and a few quiet heritage rooflines. Focal point: the sail against the river. A restrained ochre sun and a small terracotta reflection provide warmth. Preserve generous sky and water negative space; avoid turning the scene into a detailed bridge drawing.
